observations: Photos 0 and 1: front (timing side) of a used inline four cylinder petrol engine with an aluminium valve cover, a timing chain cover, crankshaft pulley, idler pulley, accessory pulleys, an alternator on the right and an oil filter low on the right.
Photo 2: top view of the valve cover showing four open spark plug wells with no ignition coils fitted, an oil filler cap, hoses and part of the wiring harness and intake still attached.
A barcode label on the timing cover (photos 0 and 1) is only partly legible, ending in something like 'A62 047'; no engine code, part number or maker's logo can be read in any photo.
The layout looks like a common Japanese four cylinder engine, but no Toyota marking or engine code is readable, so brand and displacement are not read.
Heavy grime and oily residue around the timing cover and lower block; wet, oily ground under the engine.
Rust on the engine mount bracket and some bolt heads.
Paint and chalk marks on the valve cover in photo 2.
Watermark 'UCHENNA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' on every photo, a parts dealer's photos taken in a market yard.

identity.kind: used inline 4 cylinder petrol engine (engine code and maker not readable)
read_from: photos 0 to 2 overall shape: inline four cylinder engine with four plug wells and timing chain cover

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows the four spark plug wells open with no ignition coils fitted; starter and air conditioning compressor are not shown in any photo.
No Toyota logo, engine code or part number is legible; the timing cover label is unreadable.

claims.claim: Fits SUVs and crossovers such as the Toyota RAV4 second generation (XA20)
claims.evidence: Fitment depends on the engine code stamped on the block, which is not shown.

risks.risk: Engine code and displacement unknown; they set the price and the fitment, and the claimed Toyota RAV4 fitment is not shown.
risks.proof: A sharp close up of the engine code stamped on the block and the label on the timing cover.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced as a Toyota RAV4 engine; no price until the code is read.

risks.risk: Low compression, worn rings, burning oil or a knocking bottom end.
risks.proof: A clip of the engine running on a test stand or in a car, with sound, and a compression test reading per cylinder.

risks.risk: Head gasket failure or overheating damage, cracked head or block.
risks.proof: Photo of the oil on the dipstick and under the filler cap, and of the coolant passages, plus all sides of the block.

risks.risk: Oil leaks from the timing cover or seals, suggested by the oily residue in photos 0 and 1.
risks.proof: Close ups of the timing cover seams, oil pan and rear main seal area after a wipe down.

risks.risk: Missing parts: ignition coils absent, and starter, compressor, sensors or wiring harness may be missing.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides of the engine with every ancillary named, and the coils if supplied.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a long block without coils and ancillaries not shown.

risks.risk: The unit supplied may differ from the one photographed.
risks.proof: A photo of the same engine beside a handwritten note with today's date and a code we supply, next to the engine code stamp.
risks.if_unproven: Quote conditional on the agent matching the engine code before payment.

proof_requests: A sharp close up of the engine code stamped on the block and the timing cover label.
The same engine beside a handwritten note with today's date and our code.
A clip of the engine running with sound, or compression readings per cylinder.
Photos of all four sides with ancillaries named, and of the oil on the dipstick and filler cap.
Close ups of the timing cover seams and oil pan.
response.reason: The photos show a used inline four cylinder petrol engine, but no maker, engine code or displacement is readable, and an engine is priced by its code and fitment, so the seller's Toyota RAV4 claim cannot set the price. One close up of the stamped engine code settles it; the ignition coils are already missing, so 'complete' is contradicted.
